{{Quote|I never say this to off-worlders, but I think we want you to stay. To the blockhouse!|Borjak to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor29">[[Knights of the Old Republic 29|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 29]]</ref>}}
The '''blockhouse''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odryn]] which was used as a last refuge by the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] during their warring days with the other villages. In [[3963 BBY]], fugitives [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]] were apprehended by the Feeorin after sneaking out of the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]] and were brought to the blockhouse for interrogation.<ref name="kotor29" />
